sources: vhf_transmission
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/viral-haemorrhagic-fevers-origins-reservoirs-transmission-and-guidelines
UKHSA viral haemorrhagic fever transmission guidance
VHF origins, reservoirs, transmission and professional guidance
The guidance describes origins, reservoirs and transmission routes for viral haemorrhagic fevers.
It links professional risk-assessment, infection-control and specialist-management resources.
vhf_acdp_landing
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/viral-haemorrhagic-fever-acdp-algorithm-and-guidance-on-management-of-patients
UKHSA and ACDP VHF management publication
risk assessment and immediate management of possible VHF patients
The publication provides an algorithm and guidance for managing patients who may have a VHF.
It supports consistent risk categorisation, isolation, specialist consultation and testing decisions.
vhf_acute_hospital

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/viral-haemorrhagic-fever-acdp-algorithm-and-guidance-on-management-of-patients/risk-assessment-and-immediate-management-of-viral-haemorrhagic-fevers-contact-high-consequence-infectious-diseases-in-acute-hospitals
UKHSA detailed VHF acute-hospital guidance
immediate risk assessment and management of possible VHF or contact HCID in acute hospitals
The detailed guidance supports acute hospitals assessing a possible VHF or contact HCID case.
Actions depend on travel, exposure, symptoms, clinical stability and specialist advice.
vhf_testing_landing
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/viral-haemorrhagic-fever-sample-testing-advice
UKHSA VHF sample-testing publication
specialist sample testing for possible viral haemorrhagic fever
The publication provides advice on arranging specialist VHF sample testing.
It links the current Imported Fever Service route and specimen requirements.
vhf_testing_detail
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/viral-haemorrhagic-fever-sample-testing-advice/viral-haemorrhagic-fever-vhf-sample-testing-from-the-imported-fever-service
UKHSA Imported Fever Service VHF testing guidance
eligibility, consultation, specimen and transport requirements for VHF testing
The guidance describes access to VHF testing through the Imported Fever Service.
Testing requires specialist discussion, suitable specimens, clinical details and safe transport arrangements.
hantavirus_guidance
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/hantaviruses
UKHSA hantavirus guidance
hantavirus epidemiology, transmission, symptoms, diagnosis and prevention
The guidance covers hantavirus reservoirs, transmission, clinical syndromes and prevention.
Assessment depends on geography, rodent exposure, symptoms and specialist laboratory evidence.
hantavirus_transmission_review
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/hantavirus-human-to-human-infection-transmission-parameters
UKHSA hantavirus human-transmission evidence review
evidence on human-to-human hantavirus transmission parameters
The publication reviews evidence concerning human-to-human transmission of hantaviruses.
Its findings are evidence-review outputs and must not be treated as universal operational guidance.
hantavirus_statistics
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/hantavirus-statistical-releases
UKHSA hantavirus statistical releases
official UK hantavirus case surveillance and reporting
The publication brings together statistical releases on hantavirus cases in the UK.
Counts must be interpreted with case definitions, diagnostic availability and reporting periods.
hantavirus_notified_cases
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/hantavirus-statistical-releases/notified-cases-of-hantavirus-in-the-uk
UKHSA notified hantavirus cases report
notified hantavirus cases in the UK by stated surveillance period
The page reports notified hantavirus cases for the UK using the stated surveillance scope.
Reported totals do not by themselves establish transmission setting or individual exposure pathway.
